name: zvideo_dd_shutdown_video_system
description: zVideo_dd::ShutdownVideoSystem clears the default texture record and tears down the DirectDraw/D3D backend.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVideo DirectDraw teardown/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a7d40 validates optional zVideo_dd3d::TextureRecord_Destroy on the zVideo runtime default texture record at 0x6333a8, clearing that pointer, calling zVideo_dd::TeardownVideoSubsystem, and returning zero.

The native smoke patches TeardownVideoSubsystem, verifies the default texture record is cleared and skipped by TextureRecord_Destroy, verifies teardown is called once, and verifies the no-default path still tears down and returns zero.
